title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana + logging for Private installs (Helm/Terraform/Installer)
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Enable zero-touch deployment of the observability stack for Redwood Private installs (VPC/on-prem) so customers can opt-in during installer/terraform workflows. This PR wires Helm charts, Terraform modules, and the private-installer to offer an opinionated, supported Prometheus+Grafana + log shipping (Vector/Fluent Bit) configuration with dashboards and alert rules.

Scope: This change includes a new 'observability' Terraform module, upstreamed Helm subcharts (prometheus-operator, grafana, kube-state-metrics, node-exporter), installer integration flags and manifests, log shipping via Vector (preferred) with Fluent Bit fallback, curated Grafana dashboards for model-serving/topology/latency/cost, and a set of SRE alerting rules tuned for private installs. The default is disabled; enabling is opt-in via installer UI/terraform variable.

Checklist:
- [x] Add helm subcharts and opinionated values files for Private installs
- [x] Add terraform module and examples for VPC deployment (private networking, service monitor, storageClass handling)
- [x] Integrate observability enable flag into private-installer (pre- and post-install hook)
- [x] Add Grafana dashboards and simple JSON provisioning mechanism
- [x] Add alert rules for high latency, pod-crashloops, node pressure, and prometheus remote write failures
- [x] Wire log shipping via Vector with sample parsers for Redwood runtime logs
- [x] Update docs and quickstart templates

Implementation notes:
- Helm: placed charts under redwood-private/charts/observability; values files per footprint (small/medium/large) include sensible resource requests and persistence toggles. PrometheusOperator is configured to use ClusterRoleBindings only when installer is run by an admin; installer will warn when RBAC is restricted.
- Terraform: new module at infra/terraform/modules/observability that exposes enable, namespace, storage_class, persistence, grafana_admin_password_secret, prometheus_retention. Example usage in infra/terraform/examples/private-vpc-observability. Module supports toggling between Vector and FluentBit for logs (vector by default).
- Installer: private-installer command now accepts --enable-observability and populates values templates; post-install hook waits for CRDs before installing. Rollback path removes helm releases and leaves persisted PVCs untouched unless --purge-pv is supplied.
- Dashboards/Alerts: Grafana JSON files live in redwood-private/dashboards; alert rules in redwood-private/alerts/prometheus-rules.yaml. Defaults are conservative to reduce noisy alerts in constrained private environments.

Upgrade/rollback considerations:
- Upgrades: Helm chart follows semver; installer performs a dry-run upgrade check and fails fast if CRD changes are required. For major upgrades that change storage schema, operator upgrade docs included.
- Rollback: Installer exposes --rollback-observability which rolls back the last helm release for observability components and restores previous grafana provisioning. Persistent volumes are not deleted by default to avoid data loss.

Testing:
- Unit: helm template checks + terraform validate for module.
- Integration: local K3s smoke tests in perf-canary pipeline (prometheus scrape targets, grafana provisioning, sample alert firing).
- E2E: test suite verifies enable/disable, upgrade, rollback, and log ingestion for both Vector and Fluent Bit.

Notes and follow-ups:
- Follow-up ticket created to add RBAC hardened mode to support restricted clusters (ENG-2401).
- Ops runbook added to docs/operators/observability-runbook.md (small checklist for support).
commits_summary: Add helm charts and opinionated values for prometheus, grafana, kube-state-metrics, node-exporter
Installer integration: enable-observability flag, templating, post-install hook and rollback
Add Vector log shipping manifests, sample parsers, and Fluent Bit fallback option
Add Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerting rules
Add tests: helm template, terraform validate, k3s smoke tests
review_comments: Ben Chu: overall looks good. Please make the default retention for Prometheus configurable (suggest 15d) — addressed in variables.tf and added example override.
Maya Singh: Can we avoid ClusterRole creation by default? I'm worried about airgapped clusters without cluster-admin. Reply: added installer warning and follow-up ENG-2401 to add RBAC hardened mode.
Omar Khalid: tests failing in first CI run due to k8s version skew in smoke test. Reply: pinned K3s image in pipeline and re-ran; CI green on second run.
Aisha Patel (author): Responded to comments, updated docs and added runbook with rollback steps.
merge_summary: Merged via squash on 2026-02-27 after reviewers approved. Post-merge: created release candidate tag v0.9.0-obs. Ops notified and runbook linked in the release notes. Deployed to staging private cluster for soak testing before customer rollouts.
release_notes:
- New: optional observability stack for Private installs (Prometheus + Grafana + log shipping)
- New: terraform module infra/terraform/modules/observability and installer flag --enable-observability
- Improvement: curated dashboards for model-serving and cost/latency observability
- Notes: default disabled; see docs/operators/observability-runbook.md for enable/upgrade/rollback instructions
